output.population: Persons at high risk for lung cancer enrolled from August 2002 through April 2004 at 33 U.S. medical centers and randomly assigned to annual low-dose CT or chest radiography screening
output.summary: Imaging from the National Lung Screening Trial, a randomized trial comparing low-dose CT with chest radiography for lung cancer screening; the dataset includes low-dose CT scans and digitized histopathology images from enrolled subjects.
